result.summary: Found one major layout defect: overlapping text in the restaurant metadata line under Tokumaru Ramen Bar. The rest of the page appears consistent, with the partially visible carousel item and bottom-cut card being expected behavior.

issues.description: The delivery information line under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card overlaps with the cuisine/tag text, producing garbled text ("25–30 min delivery • Ramen" is rendered on top of itself).
issues.suggestion: Lay out the metadata row as flex items with proper spacing or wrapping so the delivery time, fee, and cuisine label do not overlap.
